reason: The carousel is one continuous dinner-table conversation. Clothes must remain consistent across all seven slides.

continuity_props: Zuv's phone near or in his hand

wardrobe_all_slides.aachu: black sleeveless top, light blue denim, loose dark wavy hair, small warm-gold pendant/bracelet
wardrobe_all_slides.zuv: dark charcoal/navy casual shirt or tee, grey lounge trousers

hard_rules: Do not change outfits between slides.
Do not shift the scene to bedroom, sofa, bed, or cushion-based action.
Keep the same room, table, dinner props, lighting, faces, body proportions, and relationship distance across the full sequence.
Use camera angle, posture, hands, eye-line, phone movement, napkin gesture, and table silence for visual variety.
No formal party outfits, bridal cues, random model styling, or fashion-editorial wardrobe changes.
